# COSEN JIMTOF2026 special page

- `cosen-jp/index.html` is a self-contained static page with inline CSS and JavaScript.
- Keep the public URL and canonical URL at `https://www.kikai.work/cosen-jp/`.
- Keep asset paths relative (`./assets/...`) so the page works locally and on GitHub Pages.
- Preserve the lightweight, mobile-first design. Do not add large frameworks or external font dependencies.
- Use the responsive 640 px and 1200 px image variants in `srcset`; do not replace them with the larger source files.
- Do not change the confirmed JIMTOF booth number `S2023` without checking the current JIMTOF organizer listing.
- The inquiry form intentionally prepares a `mailto:` message; there is no server-side form handler.
